packageRules.description: Use chore commit type for GitHub Actions version updates (no package release should be triggered)
Handle Node.js updates in .nvmrc (latest dev toolchain)
Disable engines.node updates (pinned to MintMaker's minimum supported version)
Handle npm packageManager updates (latest dev toolchain)
Disable engines.npm updates (pinned to MintMaker's minimum supported version)
Lock file maintenance does not require a package release
Group all @scalprum/react-core updates (root devDependency + workspace peerDependencies) so npm ranges move in lockstep and never create an empty peer intersection. No automerge while 0.x.

Only ever widen @scalprum/react-core peer ranges. The preset's bump strategy rewrites a range like ^0.13.0 || ^0.14.0 || ^0.15.0 into a single ^0.x, dropping support for the older minors in a patch release. Widening appends a clause instead, so automated releases stay semver-correct; narrowing is a breaking change a human makes deliberately with a feat! commit.
